articles.title: Zelensky questions 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 泽连斯基对特朗普与普京的“奇怪”友谊提出质疑 | BBC 新闻
articles.summary:
Volodymyr Zelensky has voiced his frustration with the United States and questioned US President Donald Trump's relationship with Russian President Vladimir Putin in an interview with the BBC.
 
In a picture posted to Truth Social on Saturday, where Trump and Putin embrace, the US president described his Russian counterpart as "my friend".
 
"Of course it's up to the President of the United States, but... it's strange," Zelensky told the BBC's Sarah Rainsford at his office in central Kyiv.
 
"He [Putin] is an aggressor, and a killer…He can't be a friend. Just cannot be."

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在接受英国广播公司采访时表达了对美国的不满，并对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的关系提出质疑。

周六，一张特朗普和普京拥抱的照片被发布到Truth Social上，美国总统称他的俄罗斯同行为“我的朋友”。
 
“当然，这要由美国总统来决定，但是……这很奇怪。”泽连斯基在基辅市中心的办公室里对BBC记者莎拉·雷恩斯福德（Sarah Rainsford）说道。
 
“他[普京]是一个侵略者，一个杀人犯……他不可能成为朋友。”

就是不可能。”

articles.title: The '80s Campaign That Still Haunts US Parents | The Global Story
articles.titleZh: 仍困扰着美国父母的80年代运动 | 全球故事
articles.summary:
In recent years, parents across the US have faced scrutiny – and even legal consequences – for letting their children play outside unsupervised. 

American expectations of constant parental supervision differ sharply from those in other countries, where greater emphasis is placed on children’s independence and allowing them to take age-appropriate risks.

In today’s episode, The Global Story’s Asma Khalid and Tristan Redman compare their childhoods and how they raise their own kids now. 

Tristan explores how a short-lived child safety campaign from the 80s had a lasting impact with BBC executive producer Annie Brown. 

And Asma finds out what the Japanese approach to parenting can teach us about independence by talking to author Lisa Katayama.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
近年来，美国各地的父母因让孩子在无人看管的情况下在户外玩耍而受到严密审查，甚至面临法律后果。

美国人对父母持续监督的期望与其他国家大相径庭，其他国家更加重视孩子的独立性，并允许他们承担与年龄相符的风险。

在今天的节目中，《全球故事》的Asma Khalid和Tristan Redman将比较他们的童年，以及他们现在如何养育自己的孩子。

Tristan与BBC执行制片人Annie Brown一起探讨了20世纪80年代一场短暂的儿童安全运动是如何产生持久影响的。

Asma通过与作家Lisa Katayama的对话，了解了日本的育儿方式能教会我们哪些关于独立性的知识。

articles.title: Kuwait drone strike kills two Italian nationals | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 科威特无人机袭击造成两名意大利公民死亡 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Iran denies it was behind a drone attack on an air defence system in Kuwait which killed two Italian engineers. The President of the EU Commission says Europe needs to step up pressure on Tehran to end attacks on Gulf nations.
 
Meanwhile, Houthi and Saudi forces trade fresh strikes, as the Iran-backed Houthis push to take more territory in Yemen.
 
Also, the head of Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation says the country's civilian nuclear programme is "unstoppable", and accuses the US of trying to stop other countries using advanced technologies.
 
And the family of twin sisters arrested for joining anti-government protests in Iran tell the BBC they were beaten and tortured whilst on death row. It comes as there has been an increase in women being sentenced to death for taking part in protests.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Iran #Kuwait #BBCNews

articles.readingTextZh:
伊朗否认其是科威特一处防空系统遭无人机袭击事件的幕后黑手，该事件造成两名意大利工程师死亡。

欧盟委员会主席表示，欧洲需要加大对德黑兰的施压，以制止其对海湾国家的袭击。

与此同时，胡塞武装和沙特军队正在相互发动新的袭击，而伊朗支持的胡塞武装正力图在也门夺取更多领土。

此外，伊朗原子能组织负责人表示，该国的民用核计划“势不可挡”，并指责美国试图阻止其他国家使用先进技术。

一对双胞胎姐妹因参与伊朗反政府抗议活动而被捕，她们的家人向BBC透露，她们在死囚牢房中遭到殴打和酷刑。

此举正值因参与抗议活动而被判处死刑的女性人数有所增加之际。

articles.title: ‘We went into fix-it mode’: Band directors react to Macy’s parade postponement
articles.titleZh: “我们进入了‘解决问题’模式”：乐队指挥对梅西百货游行延期的反应
articles.summary:
For the first time in its history, the iconic Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed because of forecasted heavy rain and strong winds. The parade will now begin at 8:30 a.m. ET Saturday.

CNN spoke with the directors of two bands that were set to perform in Thursday’s parade and which are staying to play on Saturday.

0:43 Lafe Cook, band director at Dobyns-Bennett High School in Tennessee, on what came next
5:07 Marching Illini director Barry Houser on how they found out about the postponement
7:01 University of Illinois Marching Illini perform in Times Square Wednesday night

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#Thanksgiving #Parade #News
